title: Cold weather is coming! Here’s how to take the “Coat Test” to see if ...
description: Cold weather is coming! Here’s how to take the “Coat Test” to see if your child’s jacket or coat is safe for them to wear under their car seat harness.  Remember that if the coat adds slack to the harness, the coat will compress in a crash, and it’s as if you left the straps too loose.  Your child can stay safe AND warm by using thin, warm layers like fleece or by placing their coat on backwards over the properly snug harness! #cpst #cpstsoftiktok #childpassengersafetytech #childpassengersafetytechnician #carseatsafety #childpassengersafetytok #carseatsafetytok #carseattok #carseattiktoks #carseat #rearfacing #rearfacingcarseat #rearfacingtoddlers #forwardfacing #forwardfacingcarseat #baby #babysafety #babies #toddlers #toddlersafety #preschoolers #kids #babycarseat #allinonecarseat #convertiblecarseat #carseatharness #mom #dad #parents #momtok #dadtok #momsoftiktok #dadsoftiktok #momlife #dadlife #firsttimemom #firsttimedad #ruralmom #ruralkids #countrykids #grandma #grandpa #buckleup
